title: Coolify hardening, NetBird-on-Coolify ops, and hosting Daily Digest
summary: Practical runbook notes: keep Coolify patched and locked down, operate NetBird ZTNA safely on Coolify (mounts, Cloudflare DNS-only, no exit-node on the VPS), and host the Astro Daily Digest as a Dockerfile static app.

sections.heading: Coolify ops & hardening
bullets: Treat Coolify as a high-privilege control plane — patch aggressively; mid-2026 advisories often needed only an authenticated Member for host RCE.
Target floor after that wave: stay current (e.g. ≥ beta.474 in that series; verify against your live version such as v4.3.x).
Lock down dashboard/realtime/terminal ports (8000/6001/6002) at the cloud firewall; keep 80/443 for apps. UFW alone may not hide Docker-published ports.
Enable 2FA for Owner/Admin; disable open registration; do not invite SMB customers as Members on a shared plane.
Set strong webhook secrets on every app; rotate API tokens; use scoped tokens + IP allowlist.
Isolate customers by server/destination; back up instance + APP_KEY/.env and off-site DB/volumes before upgrades.

sections.heading: NetBird on Coolify — ops & recovery
bullets: Data durability: bind-mount outside Docker volume internals (e.g. /srv/netbird/netbird-data:/var/lib/netbird) — do not bind into /var/lib/docker/volumes/.../_data.
Healthchecks should verify DB files (store.db, 1dp.db) plus management HTTP — not TCP alone. Preserve NETBIRD_STORE_ENCRYPTION_KEY.
Cloudflare must be DNS-only (grey cloud) for the NetBird hostname (gRPC + STUN/UDP 3478). Publish UDP 3478; ensure public TCP 443 to origin if CF IP allowlists block grey-cloud TLS.
Prefer Coolify Domains UI for dashboard TLS; avoid hand-rolled Traefik labels that fight Coolify.
Never enroll the Coolify VPS as an exit node (0.0.0.0/0) shared with All — it can blackhole public traffic and take Coolify offline.
Login failures: AUTH_SUPPORTED_SCOPES should match IdP (openid profile email groups); remove unrecognized scopes like api; confirm which IdP NetBird is actually using.

sections.heading: Astro Daily Digest hosting on Coolify
bullets: Content is the source of truth: content/updates/YYYY-MM-DD.json (Zod-validated); daily work = append one file.
Best Coolify deploy path: Dockerfile app (multi-stage build → static nginx on port 80), not a long-running Node SSR process.
Set PUBLIC_SITE_URL to the public domain (e.g. https://digest.efortune.tech); auto-deploy on main.
Repo: dreadstorm/daily-pulse (Origin); WebAdmin publishes Research/Overheard payloads then triggers Coolify rebuild.
If Coolify needs GitHub/GitLab, mirror Origin or deploy via image — verify git connectivity in Coolify UI.
